analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1562.76) vs SMA5/20/50 ($1714.17/$1773.51/$1740.54) — Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, confirming a weak trend.
· Position vs SMA100 ($1575.59)/SMA200 ($1377.96) — Approaching SMA100, testing mid-to-long-term support.
· 52-week position (66.8%) + Historical significance of current price range — Significant decline from 52-week high, but still elevated from the low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (37.0→35.9) + Entering oversold territory + Downtrend continuation.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histogram -23.8756→-23.8756) + Worsening steady + No trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $1617.17) + Bandwidth at 17.63% indicates sustained volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($1441.31) + Basis (Pivot S1, based on 20-day low).
· Swing Resistance ($1603.49) + Potential for short-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Potential Lower Low formation) + Downtrend continuation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.35x vs 5-day average) + Decreased reliability of price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Observation conditions: RSI recovery above 50 and MACD improvement confirmed.
